title: Cost Advisor: safe-apply workflow + surge-protection runbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Follow-up work after a multi-tenant cost/latency incident triggered by Optimize's automated batching/caching recommendations. This ticket owns: (1) a hardened safe-apply workflow for Cost Advisor recommendation rollout, (2) a surge-protection circuit for recommendation-driven reconfigures, and (3) an on-call playbook for fast rollback and forensic metrics. Goal: prevent recommendation flips and cost spikes while preserving automated cost-savings for low-risk workloads.
acceptance_criteria: A preview/dry-run mode validates recommendation impact on 3 metrics (p99 latency, average tokens/sec, cost per million tokens) before any config apply.
Canary rollouts available per-namespace with automatic quiesce after configurable error/cost thresholds.
Automated surge-protection circuit will pause applies if aggregated tenant cost delta exceeds 15% in 10 minutes or if 95th latency increases by >30% in same window.
Rollback actions documented with one-click runbook links and CLI commands; successful rollback must restore baseline within 5 minutes in staged testing.
Playbook tested in staging runbook exercise and validated by PM, Infra-SRE, and Security in staging environment.
Instrumentation added: preview delta metrics, 'apply_id' tracing across API/console/runner, and dashboard widgets for active applies.
Unit/integration tests and a GitHub PR with deploy gates merged to main.
reproducible_steps: 1) Run Cost Advisor simulation for sample workload with --dry-run flag (examples in repo).
2) Collect preview output JSON and ingest into staging dashboard via tools/preview_ingest.sh.
3) Trigger a canary apply to a single namespace via console, observe metrics for 30 minutes.
4) Simulate traffic spike using loadgen at 2x normal QPS to confirm surge-protection fires and halts further applies.
5) Execute rollback via runbook step (CLI command) and confirm metric return to baseline within 5 minutes.
mitigation_playbook: Preflight checks: validate dry-run summary exists and all three key metrics show non-regressive or acceptable deltas.
Staging canary: schedule canary for 1% of traffic (namespace-scope); wait 30 minutes and check dashboards.
Surge-protection thresholds: (a) aggregated cost delta > 15% in 10m, (b) p95 latency +30% or p99 +20% — if any triggered, automatically pause applies and notify on-call.
Automatic rollback: when surge-protection pauses an apply, spawn async rollback job that restores previous config and tags the apply_id with failure reason.
Manual rollback: on-call run CLI: 'ri optimize rollback --apply-id <apply_id> --force' and confirm via 'ri optimize status --apply-id <apply_id>'.
Escalation: if rollback fails or doesn't restore baseline in 10 minutes, page Infra-SRE (pager duty), then eng leads (Diego Morales), then PM (Maya Singh).
Blameless postmortem: open PM-owned incident doc and include preview artifacts, apply_id, and before/after traces.
